finding_description: In evaluate_feature_hypotheses, an allow_unblind: bool = False parameter was present. Calling evaluate_feature_hypotheses(..., allow_unblind=True) allowed bypassing the REFUSED_VALIDATION_NOT_MATURE fail-closed guard on real post-start H39 validation observations (slot_ms >= 1788520500000) before maturity gates were reached. This violated the strict blindness contract of v0.3.23 where no library/API/CLI path may unblind H39.

old_bypass_shape.signature: evaluate_feature_hypotheses(observations: Sequence[H39Observation], horizon: str = '60m', allow_unblind: bool = False) -> dict[str, FeatureTestResult]
old_bypass_shape.bypass_vector: allow_unblind=True bypassed fail-closed refusal on immature fresh validation data.

new_fail_closed_behavior.signature: evaluate_feature_hypotheses(observations: Sequence[H39Observation], horizon: str = '60m') -> dict[str, FeatureTestResult]

regression_tests.description: Verifies that post-start validation observations unconditionally raise RuntimeError(REFUSED_VALIDATION_NOT_MATURE) and calling with allow_unblind=True/False raises TypeError.
Verifies that any observation with slot_ms >= H39_VALIDATION_START_MS always raises REFUSED_VALIDATION_NOT_MATURE across both 60m and 240m horizons.
Verifies TypeError when calling evaluate_feature_hypotheses with allow_unblind keyword argument, proving the old bypass cannot be used.
Verifies pre-validation/development observations (slot_ms < H39_VALIDATION_START_MS) evaluate properly across 60m and 240m horizons without triggering refusal.
Verifies check_unblind_readiness and get_blind_validation_status never execute evaluate_feature_hypotheses and expose strictly metadata without statistical fields.
Verifies CLI parser strictly rejects --allow-unblind, --force-unblind, validation-unblind, and validation-evaluate.
Verifies presence and schema of all v0.3.23 deliverables including strict unblind gate repair deliverables.
